cites.quote: doctor A has an availability block on Saturday and doctor B has blocks only on Friday
Given an Inactive doctor with an availability block on Sunday

findings.text: Weekday is stored as 1 = Monday. Filter ACs use only Saturday and Friday, which have the same number under ISO and 0 = Sunday coding, so a wrong mapping passes. No AC filters on Sunday, and none puts Sunday with other days in the column order.

cites.quote: lists only the doctors who have `at least one availability block on` that weekday
two availability blocks on Tuesday (one in the morning, one in the afternoon)

findings.text: No filter AC has a doctor with two blocks on the chosen weekday. A join-based filter (the likeliest wrong implementation) lists that doctor twice and inflates the total, and every S-2/S-3 AC would still pass.

cites.quote: combines with search and the department, specialization and status

findings.text: REQ-7 says Works on combines with search, department, specialization and status. S-3 has ACs for search, department and status, but none for the specialization filter.
